notes.title: Pre-orders for Nendoroid Jill Stingray Re-Release NOW OPEN!
notes.notes: [p]She's back![/p][p]Good Smile Company have announced a re-release of the iconic Nendoroid Jill Stingray (and Fore!).[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25278042/99d82d2d294a4eaac482824a1bab5e9db11dac76.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25278042/2572340fbd6d5453ca5e705ed3cb6d0b7486ff0c.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25278042/a63615b558629745c961a748013b9a45149a80e6.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25278042/a1bd3d4d66fad68f116c8e43c3fa82b728983fb7.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25278042/47f37cab0b5617742df73f2942a1e8da452eccc2.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]All pre-orders from [b]Good Smile US [/b]at [url="https://goodsmile.link/N22Twz"]https://goodsmile.link/N22Twz[/url] will receive an exclusive Background Sheet featuring one of the bar's, uh, regular visitors.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25278042/f446843fd9328318463318c4ec624a9d9ba0f9ca.png"][/img][/p][p]Pre-orders are also available from [b]Good Smile Japan[/b] at [url="https://goodsmile.link/uHGe2I"]https://goodsmile.link/uHGe2I[/url] and [b]Good Smile EU[/b] at [url="http://goodsmile.cc/43QGm0B"]http://goodsmile.cc/43QGm0B[/url]![/p][p][/p][p]Jill also comes with her cocktail shaker, a martini glass and a mini figure of Fore as optional parts. Plus interchangeable face plates! Enjoy creating all kinds of poses and situations! Be sure to add her to your collection![/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.2.1.3
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25278042/04637aef6afa626a073a2ad398f26bb37167a381.png[/img]

Master, we're in a loose spot.

There is nothing special about this patch.

-Minimal bug fixes
-Repacked songs inside the game data due to licensing issues

Some people have noticed the voice beeps changed. This is unintended, so we'll probably fix that later.

Some have also reported creepy images inside the game folder, but I don't know about that.

In the name of Sukeban...

PS: 我们正在为支持中文字体而努力，请稍等！

notes.title: Update 1.1.0.3 is now LIVE!
notes.notes:
This patch addresses the following bugs and errors:

[list]

[*][strike]This game's existence.[/strike]

[*]Nacho's beeps properly sound when he talks.

[*]Save files now show a leading zero when needed (Only shown in newly saved data, old saves will not show it).

[*]Game can now be closed with Alt+F4.

[*]Game now remembers if it should launch in full screen or not.

[*]Skip button deactivates while pressing Shift first (So puush users can send screens).

[*]Mixing keyboard shortcuts are now stable and complete.

[*]Advancing text through a gamepad is no longer possible to avoid gamepad-related bugs (Proper gamepad support will be added in a future update).

[*]Added message to the post-credits save screen to clarify that you can save New Game Plus data (dubbed HEART Data) there.

[*]New Game Plus intro talk no longer triggers if you complete the game and press New Game (You need to load the HEART data to see it, as intended).

[*]The flag for completing the shooter minigame now remains after New Game Plus.

[*]PC-9X no longer appears over everything if you fail to pay the light bill.

[*]Boss' bullets no longer remain on screen during the shmup minigame's victory sequence.

[*]Fixed assorted typos across the game

[/list]

Remember to report all bugs, typos and nitpicks at the forums!
